payload.title: R7: One optional challenge per lesson; unlock edits after the goal; stars on the end card (S)
payload.description:
Effort: S.

**Problem.** Walls are narrow; edits are locked after the goal.
**Evidence.** Only another-way (02) and below-zero (08) are open; the student is not told a star exists; the coach end card shows no stars; lock: [edit, drag, toggle] in lessons 3, 5, 6, 8.
**Change.** One 'Try this too' line per lesson stated at the start (e.g. lesson 2: biggest number a card can hold; spinner -2048 to 2047); unlock edits once the goal is met; show stars on the end card.
**Acceptance.**
- Given any lesson, then it states one optional challenge at the start.
- When the goal is met, then edits are unlocked.
- The end card shows stars earned.
